mark_scheme.criterion: States work done or energy transferred per unit time (accept rate of doing work or rate of energy transfer).

hints: Recall the controlled syllabus definition of power.
Make sure to include both work/energy and time in your definition.
solution: Power is defined as work done or energy transferred per unit time.
teacher_walkthrough: Remind students that Cambridge requires 'per unit time' or 'rate of'.
Do not accept simply 'work over time' or 'energy divided by time' without clear qualification of rate.
